Players Committee card image of [[Rose Tico (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If Finn is about to be lost from same site, may place him in Used Pile instead. During your control phase, if present at a battleground site, and another Resistance character on table (or Paige out of play), may retrieve 1 Force.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
